summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Canadian Form 51-102F3 material change report dated September 15, 2026, disclosing that director Karen Narwold resigned from the board effective September 15, 2026, after accepting a new executive position with increased time commitments. The board now comprises eight directors, and the company has begun a search for a new independent director, intending to announce an appointment later. No deal terms, advisors, or shareholder recommendations are stated. This is a routine board-composition change rather than a forced or abrupt departure constituting a special situation.
